title: FoldEnergetics-xTB: AlphaFold PAE Domain Partitioning, Foldseek 3Di Homology Search & Semiempirical Quantum Pocket Triage
description: FoldEnergetics-xTB is a structural bioinformatics and quantum biochemistry package developed by the Computational Genomics & Agentic Systems (CGAS) Lab at Northwestern University. It couples AlphaFold 3 Predicted Aligned Error (PAE) graph partitioning with Foldseek 3Di structural homology alignment and GFN2-xTB semiempirical quantum-chemical calculations to triage small-molecule ligand-binding pockets.
